unsloth-base-mtp.note: what the user runs today: Qwen3.6 UD-Q4_K_XL with MTP head, unsloth's own quant recipe. NOT a fair speed comparison against our own builds (different conversion/calibration, no shared lineage) -- use base-q4km-mtp for that instead.

base-q4km.note: exact-recipe control: unpruned Qwen3.6, our Q4_K_M. Verified this has NO mtp tensors (fails to load with --spec-type draft-mtp: 'model doesn't contain MTP layers') -- our hf-to-gguf conversion silently drops embedded mtp.* tensors unless they're split into their own model-mtp.safetensors shard first. See base-q4km-mtp for the MTP-preserved twin of this exact build.

base-q4km-mtp.note: base-q4km's exact twin: same original Qwen3.6-35B-A3B checkpoint, same hf-to-gguf convert + plain Q4_K_M (no imatrix), only difference is the 19 mtp.* tensors were extracted into their own model-mtp.safetensors shard first (same trick used for the healed-C build) so the converter picks them up as blk.40.nextn.*. This -- not unsloth-base-mtp -- is the honest base+MTP comparison point for 27B-A2.8B-mtp and 27B-A2.8B-finishing, since it shares their exact lineage minus the pruning/healing/finishing steps.
